route: Included Codex decision-maker (GPT-6 family) with local CPython. The worker wrote the per-cutoff selector, reused broker_control for notice and TAP validation, eligibility and local packet reads, and decoded originals with avro_packet. The TAP index supplied order and candidate identities. Original packets supplied photometry, qualifying metadata, and SHA-256. Each pair was decided in its own numbered folder before the next was opened.
timing_scope: The broader start marker was taken after reading TASK.md, alongside the first input inventory. The end marker follows writing answers.json. This elapsed time includes review, script construction and checkpoint inspection. The program clocks below include setup from the first lines of Python and checkpoint waits. Event clocks exclude waits and output serialization.
